Chapter 862: Chapter 8: One Man Blocks the Way, Myriad Clans Halt (Please Subscribe)

Splash.

Xia Qin, the supreme being, looked towards the super battlefield. With a wave of his right hand, nearly two hundred Level Eleven powerhouses plunged into the edge region of the battlefield like falling stars.

The other eight human supreme beings did the same, with a large number of Level Eleven powerhouses from the Human Civilization Alliance rapidly falling into the edge of the super battlefield.

Following that.

The peak tribes began sending their own Level Eleven warriors into the edge of the super battlefield.

“Xia Qin, did that human ‘Xueyu’ also go in?” a supreme being from the Star Alliance transmitted a message to inquire.

Not long ago, space-time fluctuations that indicated an assault on the ultimate level emanated from the human civilization’s territory, leading many foreign supreme beings to speculate that the perpetrator might be the human known as Xueyu.

Judging from the performance of human Xueyu within the Two-dimensional World, even if it was through the use of some treasure to exhibit such exceptional combat power, his own level must be at least Level Eleven Perfect.

It is estimated to be closer to level twelve than the Four Divine Kings.

Therefore, such speculation by the foreign supreme beings arose.

But it is just speculation after all, and no one can say for sure whether it is indeed the human Xueyu.

“Why don’t you find out for yourself later?”

Xia Qin, the supreme being, replied nonchalantly, not intending to disclose any information about Lin Yuan.

“Hehe…”

The supreme being from the Star Alliance stopped talking. The Human Civilization Alliance has Xueyu, but wouldn’t their Star Alliance have beings of similar caliber?

The Four Divine Kings were overwhelmed by the human Xueyu in the Two-dimensional World, but the environment of the Two-dimensional World is special. This super battlefield isn’t like that.

It’s not easy to defeat the warriors of the Star Alliance on this super battlefield.

Several supreme beings from the Star Alliance, in order to redeem their previous humiliation, have already prepared multiple backup plans.

…

Super battlefield.

Edge region.

Lin Yuan quickly broke free from the falling momentum and gently landed on the ground.

“This is the edge region of the super battlefield?”

Lin Yuan surveyed his surroundings, seeing ancient trees that reached the sky in every direction, lush and endless.

These ancient trees, each one radiating powerful vitality, would potentially transform into real life forms in the Main Universe if not for the space-time suppression of the battlefield.

“Are there only three Level Eleven from the Human Civilization Alliance that have fallen into this area?”

Following the Causal Sensing, Lin Yuan determined the number of Level Eleven of the Human Civilization in this area.

The edge region of the super battlefield encompasses three hundred and thirty-three zones, with each zone containing only four Level Eleven warriors from the Human Civilization Alliance—it’s considered quite unlucky.

With so few Level Eleven warriors from the Human Civilization Alliance, they are bound to face targeted oppression and competition when attempting to secure the Space-Time Path that leads to the core area.

Of course.

All of these are based on the premise.

That there is no Lin Yuan.

“Where is the Space-Time Path… there?”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed for a while. Among the three hundred and thirty-three edge regions, each one has a Space-Time Path in a certain location.

And this Space-Time Path is easy to find, as long as one slightly senses the space-time fluctuations.

“The space-time suppression is formidable; long-distance Spatial Transposition is very difficult.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

That is the reason why the three hundred thirty-three edge regions have only left one Space-Time Path.

Without the ability to use Spatial Transposition, even Level Eleven Perfect powerhouses would take too long flying from the edge region to the central area—likely the war of the super battlefield would be over by then.

Only through the Space-Time Path can one reach the central area at the fastest speed and then participate in the struggle for dominance among the twelve peak tribes.

“However, with my Sixth Realm comprehension of space-time, I can still perform Spatial Transposition, but not as extreme as billions of light-years in one step like in the outside world.”

Lin Yuan tried a little and came to a conclusion.

If this is the situation even for him, then those Level Eleven powerhouses could probably only fly slowly.

“First, let’s reach that Space-Time Path.”

Lin Yuan took a step and vanished on the spot.

…

Meanwhile.

In the edge region where Lin Yuan had arrived.

One after another, Level Eleven warriors from different clans began observing their surroundings.

“This area… we have fifty-three Level Eleven from my Star Alliance, we’ve got this.”

A huge rocky life form followed the Causal Sensing with a smile on its face.

Tens of thousands of Level Eleven strong beings have descended to the three hundred thirty-three edge regions, averaging to about two hundred Level Eleven per region.

With two hundred Level Eleven from the alliance of the twelve peak tribes, the Star Alliance’s twenty-three Level Eleven, exceeding the average number, is more likely to take advantage.

Fifty-three Level Eleven from the Star Alliance joining hands could probably all enter the Space-Time Path and reach the central area.

Once there, the influence of the Star Alliance in the central area will strengthen, which might impact the final outcome of the battle.

…

In another desolate plain.

A figure clad in pitch-black armor stood silently.

“In this area, my Prison Tribe only has twelve Level Eleven?” The figure clad in black armor, who was from the Prison Tribe, grinned and said, “But with me here, among the hundred spots on the Space-Time Path, my Prison Tribe will secure twelve.”

This Prison Tribe warrior, at the fifth tier of Level Eleven, wielded a supreme weapon.

Among the tens of thousands of Level Eleven from the twelve peak tribes, only several hundred to a thousand qualified to wield supreme weapons.

Distributed across the three hundred thirty edge regions, there may only be one or two warriors of this level in each region.

Therefore, the Prison Tribe warrior was very confident that with a supreme weapon, he believed himself to stand at the pinnacle of the tens of thousands of Level Eleven, with only those Level Eleven who also held supreme weapons posing a threat to him.
